Class NodeCacheService

java.lang.Object
com.meshtastic.client.service.NodeCacheService
public final class NodeCacheService extends Object
Local persistent node cache.

Stores accumulated node information between application sessions in the embedded H2 database ~/.meshapp/nodedb. Used as a fallback when DeviceState.getNodeDb() has no data.

The key is node_id, a string such as !9e755af0, which is the stable node identifier from Meshtastic User.id.

Updated from config exchange data and live packets (NODEINFO_APP, POSITION_APP, TELEMETRY_APP). Database writes happen immediately through MERGE INTO, without debounce.

      public void update(NodeData fresh)
      Updates a node in the cache and database. Merge semantics apply: new non-empty fields overwrite old ones, while zero/empty fields do not erase existing data.
      Parameters:
      fresh - fresh data to merge; nodeId is taken from fresh

    • updateAll

      public void updateAll(Map<Integer,NodeData> nodes)
      Bulk node update, usually after config exchange. Each node is merged with the cache, then written to the database in a batch.
      Parameters:
      nodes - node map from DeviceState.getNodeDb()

    • enrichFromCache

      public void enrichFromCache(NodeData node)
      Enriches a bare node, such as one without a name, from cache/H2 data. Only missing identity fields are filled: longName, shortName, role, hwModel, and publicKey. Telemetry and position are left untouched because the node already has fresh data from the device.
      Parameters:
      node - DeviceState node to enrich

      Loads telemetry entries for a specific node over the given period. Filtering by nodeId, period, zero-value artifacts, and future timestamps is performed in SQL.

    • importFromOneMesh

      public int importFromOneMesh() throws Exception
      Downloads and imports nodes from the OneMesh JSON file into the H2 cache.

      File format: array of arrays, where each inner array is one node. Position mapping:

      • [1] - nodeNum, unsigned int as string
      • [2] - longName
      • [3] - shortName
      • [4] - hwModel, numeric Meshtastic HardwareModel code
      • [5] - role, numeric Meshtastic Config.DeviceConfig.Role code
      • [12] - latitude, raw int multiplied by 1e-7 for degrees
      • [13] - longitude, raw int multiplied by 1e-7 for degrees
      • [16] - altitude in meters
      • [17] - lastHeard, ISO 8601 timestamp
      • [18] - batteryLevel
      • [19] - voltage as string
      Returns:
      number of imported nodes
      Throws:
      Exception - on download or parsing errors
